body.x: HUAWEI participated in ‘CES 2018(Consumer Technology Show)’, the world’s largest IT consumer electronics show held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. from Tues. 9th to Fri. 12th in Jan. and introduced ‘Mate 10 pro’ with enhanced camera performance and ‘Smart Home System’ useful for life.

‘Mate 10 pro’ is the result of working with the camera brand ‘Leica’ engineering and has two Leica lenses on the back. Recognizing real-time scenes and subjects is also a big advantage of the product. It detects 13 kinds of subjects and scenes such as characters, food, stage, blue sky, snow, beach, dog, cat, night view, plant, portrait, and flower, and shows the best result. HUAWEI also showed a smart home system that can connect appliances and apps. Smooth roaming on Wi-Fi network is possible. It is suitable for house in any size or shape.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
